en.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: All 36 New Recipes in The Keepsake Sea Revealed
en.summary: Dive into the depths of Disney Dreamlight Valley's latest expansion, The Keepsake Sea, and uncover a treasure trove of new culinary creations. We've got the full list of ingredients for all 36 unique recipes.
en.body:
Get ready to don your chef's hat and dive deep, because **Disney Dreamlight Valley**'s **The Keepsake Sea** expansion has officially surfaced, bringing with it a bounty of new ingredients and, more importantly, a whopping 36 brand-new recipes to discover and cook. This underwater realm, accessible on November 18th, 2026, promises more than just stunning visuals; it's a culinary playground for dedicated players.

This isn't just a few extra dishes; **The Keepsake Sea** expansion meticulously divides these culinary delights into three distinct categories: 12 Appetizers, 10 Entrées, and 14 Desserts. The challenge, as often is the case in **Disney Dreamlight Valley**, lies in figuring out the precise combination of ingredients needed for each dish. Players will need to explore the new underwater areas, gathering unique resources like seaweed and potentially working alongside characters like Dory from *Finding Nemo*, who is confirmed to be part of this expansion and offers her own unique rewards.

## A Culinary Deep Dive

Navigating the culinary landscape of **The Keepsake Sea** requires a keen eye and a willingness to experiment. While the game provides many ingredients, the exact recipes are left for players to uncover. This expansion builds upon the game's established crafting and cooking mechanics, encouraging players to become familiar with the new biomes such as Shipwreck Shores, Candy Cove, and the Kingdom of Oublie. Each location likely holds specific ingredients crucial for unlocking these new culinary achievements. The sheer volume of recipes suggests a significant time investment for completionists aiming to master every meal.

## What This Means for Valley Chefs

For the passionate **Disney Dreamlight Valley** community, **The Keepsake Sea** recipes represent a significant new goal. These aren't just about filling out a collection; they often tie into character quests, friendship level progression, and the overall completion of the game. The introduction of underwater exploration means a whole new layer of gameplay is added, making resource gathering more interactive and engaging. Players who have mastered the existing cooking system will find a familiar yet challenging new frontier in these aquatic dishes. It’s a testament to the ongoing commitment to expanding the game's content and keeping players invested in the magical world of Dreamlight.

## What's Next

The **Keepsake Sea** expansion launched on November 18th, 2026, and is available as part of the **Ultimate Edition 2026** or as a separate purchase. Players can now explore these underwater areas and begin their quest to discover all 36 recipes. Further updates and bug fixes are expected to follow, as is standard for **Disney Dreamlight Valley**'s ongoing development cycle.
